Violent crime rose in New Kensington and Arnold in 2024 and fell in Lower Burrell

What each police department reported to the FBI, through 2024

  • New Kensington · Up · 54 in 2024 (4.6 per 1,000), from 40 in 2023 (3.4)
  • Arnold · Up · 39 in 9 months of 2024 (about 4.3 a month), from 22 in 10 months of 2022 (about 2.2 a month)
  • Lower Burrell · Down · 10 in 2024 (0.9 per 1,000), from 17 in 11 months of 2023 (about 1.5 a month)

Source: FBI UCR via Jacob Kaplan
